Why no deep rift valley on fast-spreading ridges?
Continuous magma supply keeps crust hot and buoyant; slow ridges are cooler, weaker, rifted
Depth where carbonate production rate = dissolution rate; below this, no calcareous ooze
Why is the Pacific CCD shallower than Atlantic?
Pacific deep water older, more CO₂-rich → more acidic → dissolves carbonate faster
